message: Typing "peas" or "eggs" in the grocery list no longer suggests peanut butter or eggplant. Items like "creamy peanut butter", "red bell pepper", "vanilla ice cream", tofu, soup and cat litter now go to the right aisle. Scaled amounts in grams or milliliters no longer show fractions, and recipe nutrition no longer counts "2 avocados" as 2 ounces. A repeat now keeps its last day when your day starts after midnight, moving a routine on the 31st onto a shorter month keeps it on the 31st afterward, and the calendar no longer shows expected repeats on days that have already passed.
